children: Vontier Corporation (NYSE: VNT), a leading global provider of critical technologies and solutions to connect, manage and scale the mobility ecosystem, today announced that Tesco will integrate technologies from Gilbarco Veeder-Root and Invenco to create a scalable and efficient fuelling solution across the retailer’s petrol stations.

Building on the integration between Invenco’s outdoor payment applications and Gilbarco Veeder-Root’s fuelling and forecourt management systems, Tesco will gain deeper operational insights and a smoother customer experience.

“By leveraging the combined strengths of our market-leading businesses, Vontier is proud to deliver integrated solutions designed to best serve the unique needs of our customers,” said Andy Bennett, Group President of Convenience Retail at Vontier. “Today's announcement combines the retail expertise of Tesco with the best-in-fuelling from Gilbarco Veeder-Root and best-in-payment from Invenco to create a state-of-the-art solution.”

Gilbarco Veeder-Root’s DOMS PSS 5000 Forecourt Controller and Invenco’s connected outdoor payment terminals will enable fast and compliant transactions at the pump or at the kiosk. The controller provides specialised software that connects Tesco’s Point of Sale (POS) and software seamlessly, providing real-time data on all aspects of the forecourt.

The modular hardware and software architecture create a scalable solution for Tesco, helping the retailer enhance efficiency, improve customer experience and support future innovation. Together, Vontier’s integrated technologies are helping power a more connected and seamless mobility ecosystem.

Vontier (NYSE: VNT) is a global technology company uniting productivity, automation and multi-energy technologies to meet the needs of a rapidly evolving, more connected mobility ecosystem. Leveraging leading market positions, decades of domain expertise and unparalleled portfolio breadth, Vontier powers the way the world moves - delivering smart, safe and sustainable solutions to our customers and the planet. Built to help customers adapt and innovate to stay ahead, Invenco is the operating system for convenience retail, producing agile solutions for accelerated growth and value.
